rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday noun for a casual greeting or the act of acknowledging someone.

example.english: When I see an old friend, I always give them a greeting.
example.traditional: 見到老朋友，我一定會打個招呼。
example.jyutping: gin3 dou2 lou5 pang4 jau5 ngo5 jat1 ding6 wui5 daa2 go3 ziu1 fu1

rows.note: Use this for a conventional salutation or greeting formula, especially at the start of a letter or other written message.

example.english: The greeting at the beginning of this letter is very appropriate.
example.traditional: 呢封信開頭嘅問候語寫得好得體。
example.jyutping: ni1 fung1 seon3 hoi1 tau4 ge3 man6 hau6 jyu5 se2 dak1 hou2 dak1 tai2
